kv18.4:1.1: buddhassa bhagavato uccārapassāvo ativiya aññe gandhajāte adhigaṇhātī’ti.
kv18.4:1.7: hañci bhagavā odanakummāsaṃ bhuñjati, no ca vata re vattabbe
kv18.4:1.8: “buddhassa bhagavato uccārapassāvo ativiya añño gandhajāte adhigaṇhātī’ti.
kv18.4:2.1: buddhassa bhagavato uccārapassāvo ativiya aññe gandhajāte adhigaṇhātī’ti.
kv18.4:2.3: atthi keci buddhassa bhagavato uccārapassāvaṃ nahāyanti. vilimpenti ucchādenti. peḷāya paṭisāmenti. karaṇḍāya nikkhipenti. āpaṇe pasārenti. tena ca gandhena gandhakaraṇīyaṃ karontī’ti.
